```{r}
library(bnlearn)
data = read.csv("../data/data_clean.csv")
data$wc = as.numeric(data$wc) # importante que WC sea también float y no integer
head(data)
```
```{r}
# Dag con HC
best_dag = hc(data)
graphviz.plot(best_dag, shape = "ellipse")
```

```{r}
# Max y Diego
dag_max_diego = model2network("[age][bgr][sod][pot][wc|age:bp][bp|age:bgr:sod:pot][sc|bp][bu|bp][hemo|age:bp]")
graphviz.plot(dag_max_diego, shape = "ellipse")
```
```{r}
# Roomie Angelo
dag_roomie_angelo = model2network("[age][sod][pot][hemo][bp|age:sod:pot:hemo][bu|age][bgr|age][sc|bp][wc|age]")
graphviz.plot(dag_roomie_angelo, shape = "ellipse")
```
```{r}
# Val y amiga
dag_val_amiga = model2network("[age][bu][sc][sod|bu][pot|sc][bp|sod:pot:age][bgr|age][hemo|bp][wc|pot]")
graphviz.plot(dag_val_amiga, shape = "ellipse")
```
```{r}
# Ajuste de datos
fit_max_diego = bn.fit(dag_max_diego, data = data)
fit_roomie_angelo = bn.fit(dag_roomie_angelo, data = data)
fit_val_amiga = bn.fit(dag_val_amiga, data = data)
```

```{r}
# BIC-G y AIC-G 
score(dag_max_diego, data = data, type = "bic-g")
score(dag_roomie_angelo, data = data, type = "bic-g")
score(dag_val_amiga, data = data, type = "bic-g")

score(dag_max_diego, data = data, type = "aic-g")
score(dag_roomie_angelo, data = data, type = "aic-g")
score(dag_val_amiga, data = data, type = "aic-g")

# El DAG con menores métricas es el de Valeria
```
